mimo.courses.description: Shown when browsing the list of courses

mimo.course.description: Shown when viewing the page of a course (e.g. Python, Full-Stack Development)

mimo.path.description: Shown when viewing the learning path (the sections of a course) in the web app

mimo.lesson.description: Shown when taking a lesson in the web app

mimo.challenge.description: Shown when solving a coding challenge (an exercise checked with tests)

mimo.aiTutor.description: Shown when chatting with Mimo's AI tutor during a lesson

mimo.projects.description: Shown when browsing the user's own coding projects

mimo.project.description: Shown when working on a coding project in the editor

mimo.sharedProject.description: Shown when viewing a project that someone shared

mimo.practice.description: Shown when practicing (reviewing what was learned)

mimo.library.description: Shown when browsing the library of courses in the web app

mimo.leaderboard.description: Shown when viewing the leaderboard (weekly ranking of learners)

mimo.streak.description: Shown when viewing the learning streak (consecutive days learning)

mimo.dailyGoal.description: Shown when choosing how much to learn every day

mimo.gettingStarted.description: Shown during the onboarding of a new user

mimo.pro.description: Shown when viewing Mimo Pro, the paid subscription

mimo.glossary.description: Shown when browsing the glossary of a programming language

mimo.glossaryTerm.description: Shown when reading a glossary entry (a programming term or concept)

mimo.tutorials.description: Shown when browsing the tutorials of a programming language

mimo.compilers.description: Shown when browsing the online code compilers

mimo.compiler.description: Shown when using an online code compiler (an editor that runs code in the browser)

mimo.certifications.description: Shown when viewing Mimo's programming certifications

mimo.learnerStories.description: Shown when reading stories of people who learned to code with Mimo

mimo.buttonViewCourse.description: Button label that opens the page of a course

mimo.buttonViewProject.description: Button label that opens a shared coding project
